mapper.select:
select v.id, v.student_id, v.reason, v.score, v.occur_date, v.handler, v.remark, v.create_time, s.name as studentName, s.no as studentNo from student_violation v left join student s on v.student_id = s.id
and v.student_id = #{studentId}
and s.name like concat('%', #{studentName}, '%')
order by v.occur_date desc, v.id desc

select v.id, v.student_id, v.reason, v.score, v.occur_date, v.handler, v.remark, v.create_time, s.name as studentName, s.no as studentNo from student_violation v left join student s on v.student_id = s.id where v.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into student_violation (student_id, reason, score, occur_date, handler, remark, create_time) values (#{studentId}, #{reason}, #{score}, #{occurDate}, #{handler}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
